comparison: matched seed-42 base-stage five-cache versus caches-3 symbolic route, payload, and composition adaptation

decision.reason: caches-3 fails the route constituent edge qualification while the five-cache control retains both edges perfectly
decision.reader_architecture_consequence: caches-3 has an additional capability failure and remains unpromoted
decision.supported_result: payload survives sharing but route retrieval does not
decision.unsupported_claim: cache sharing preserves constituent retrieval while leaving only composition unchanged

findings: the matched five-cache base control reproduces finding 23: route and payload are 100 percent while direct composition remains near 45 percent
caches-3 preserves payload at 100 percent but route exact/candidate falls to 53 percent and route specificity falls to chance
direct composition is nearly unchanged at 46 percent, but this cannot be interpreted as a composition result because the route edge is unqualified
target-direction accuracy remains 100 percent for every view, again showing that raw sensitivity is weaker than association specificity
both symbolic adapters materially damage original-language loss despite 50 percent replay, so this recipe is not promotion-safe
the route/payload asymmetry is a new architecture-sensitive diagnostic and strengthens the decision not to promote caches-3
